{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check how many -999.0 values are in each arm
sentinel_mask = df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999.0
print("Sentinel values by arm:")
print(df[sentinel_mask]['arm'].value_counts())

# Check if there's a systematic difference in the distribution of sentinel values between arms
print(f"\nTotal sentinel values: {sentinel_mask.sum()}")
print(f"\nTotal patients in control arm: {df['arm'].eq('control').sum()}")
print(f"\nTotal patients in treatment arm: {df['arm'].eq('treatment').sum()}")

# Calculate proportion of sentinel values in each arm
control_sentinel_prop = df[sentinel_mask]['arm'].eq('control').sum() / df['arm'].eq('control').sum()
treatment_sentinel_prop = df[sentinel_mask]['arm'].eq('treatment').sum() / df['arm'].eq('treatment').sum()

print(f"\nProportion of sentinel values in control arm: {control_sentinel_prop:.3f}")
print(f"\nProportion of sentinel values in treatment arm: {treatment_sentinel_prop:.3f}")"}
